questions.context_sentence: Sweat your way to good health and fitness!
questions.cn: 通过流汗来获得健康和健壮！
questions.hint: 联想记忆：fit (适合的，健康的) + ness (名词后缀) = 健康，健壮。
questions.prompt: Sweat your way to good health and ____!

questions.context_sentence: Would you like to go to the soccer game?
questions.cn: 你想去看足球比赛吗？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：soc（来自association，协会）+ cer（人）-> 协会足球。

questions.context_sentence: It's in the new city stadium.
questions.cn: 它在新的城市体育场里。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：stad (站，立) + ium (场所) -> 站满观众的地方，即体育场。

questions.context_sentence: Do you want to watch the boxing match?
questions.cn: 你想看拳击比赛吗？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：box (箱子，拳击) + ing -> 拳击运动。
questions.prompt: Do you want to watch the ____ match?

questions.context_sentence: I have to meet my badminton coach for training.
questions.cn: 我得去见我的羽毛球教练进行训练。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：bad (坏的) + min (小) + ton (吨) -> 坏的小吨位羽毛球。

questions.context_sentence: Why not run an exciting marathon?
questions.cn: 为什么不跑一场激动人心的马拉松呢？
questions.hint: 背景记忆：源自希腊地名马拉克松（Marathon），士兵菲迪皮德斯为传递捷报不停奔跑而死。

questions.meaning: 比赛项目；大事；公开活动
questions.context_sentence: Did you hear that there's an e-sports event this weekend?
questions.cn: 你听说这周末有一个电子竞技比赛吗？
questions.hint: 词根词缀：e (出) + vent (来) -> 出来的事情，即大事、活动或比赛项目。
questions.prompt: Did you hear that there's an e-sports ____ this weekend?

questions.meaning: phr. 跟随；到达；进步；赶快
questions.context_sentence: Would you like to come along?
questions.cn: 你想一起来吗？
questions.hint: 直译记忆：come (来) + along (沿着) -> 跟着一起来。

questions.meaning: adj. 滑雪的 & vi. 滑雪
questions.context_sentence: Zhangjiakou will host the Youth Ski Race in December.
questions.cn: 张家口将于12月主办青年滑雪比赛。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：ski 和 sky (天空) 很像，滑雪时速度快得像在天空中飞翔。

questions.meaning: vt. 主办；主持 & n. 主人；东道主
questions.context_sentence: Zhangjiakou will host the Youth Ski Race in December.
questions.cn: 张家口将于12月主办青年滑雪比赛。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：host (主人) 负责 host (主办) 晚会。
questions.prompt: Zhangjiakou will ____ the Youth Ski Race in December. (提示: 主办)

questions.meaning: n. 跑道；足迹 & vt. & vi. 追踪；跟踪
questions.context_sentence: A great event for track-and-field lovers on 26 October.
questions.cn: 10月26日田径爱好者的一个盛大活动。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：卡车 (truck) 在跑道 (track) 上行驶。
questions.prompt: A great event for ____-and-field lovers on 26 October.

questions.context_sentence: A great event for track-and-field lovers on 26 October.
questions.cn: 10月26日田径爱好者的一个盛大活动。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：track (径赛跑道) + field (田赛场地) -> 田径。

questions.context_sentence: Wonderful gym, isn't it?
questions.cn: 很棒的健身房，不是吗？
questions.hint: 缩写记忆：gymnasium的缩写，g-y-m 就像是健身器械的简化形状。

questions.context_sentence: He does gymnastics to keep in shape.
questions.cn: 他做体操来保持身材。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：gym (健身房) + nas (鼻) + tics -> 在健身房练体操练到流鼻血。
questions.prompt: He does ____ to keep in shape.

questions.context_sentence: Come and work out at a gym!
questions.cn: 来健身房锻炼吧！
questions.hint: 短语记忆：work (工作，起作用) + out (出来) -> 锻炼出好身材。

questions.meaning: vi. 出汗 & vt. 使出汗 & n. 汗水
questions.context_sentence: Sweat your way to good health!
questions.cn: 通过流汗来获得健康！
questions.hint: 联想记忆：喝甜水 (sweet) 容易出汗 (sweat)。

questions.meaning: phr. 获得成功；准时到达
questions.context_sentence: You can make it!
questions.cn: 你能成功的！
questions.hint: 口语记忆：make (制造，做到) + it (它) -> 做到它，即获得成功。
questions.prompt: You can ____! (提示: 获得成功)

questions.meaning: n. 传奇故事（或人物）；传说
questions.context_sentence: Help us choose some 'Living Legends of Sports'.
questions.cn: 帮我们选择一些“体育界的活传奇”。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：leg (腿) + end (结束) -> 腿跑到了终点，成为了传奇。

questions.context_sentence: They must be athletes who are masters in their sports.
questions.cn: 他们必须是各自运动项目中的高手。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：ath (谐音：爱死) + lete (力体) -> 爱死有力量和体魄的运动员。

questions.meaning: n. 高手；主人 & vt. 精通；掌握
questions.context_sentence: They must be athletes who are masters in their sports.
questions.cn: 他们必须是各自运动项目中的高手。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：ma (妈妈) + s + ter (特) -> 妈妈是个特别的高手。
questions.prompt: They must be athletes who are ____ in their sports.

questions.context_sentence: They must also set good examples for others.
questions.cn: 他们还必须为其他人树立好榜样。
questions.hint: 直译记忆：set (树立) + an example (一个例子) = 树立榜样。
questions.prompt: They must also ____ for others. (提示: 树立榜样)

questions.context_sentence: As a player, Lang Ping brought honour and glory to her country.
questions.cn: 作为一名运动员，郎平为她的国家带来了荣誉和光荣。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：h不发音，on (在...上) + our (我们的) -> 荣誉在我们身上。

questions.context_sentence: As a player, Lang Ping brought honour and glory to her country.
questions.cn: 作为一名运动员，郎平为她的国家带来了荣誉和光荣。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：glo (发光，glow) + ry -> 闪闪发光的东西就是光荣。

questions.context_sentence: She led the China women's volleyball team to medals at world championships.
questions.cn: 她率领中国女子排球队在世界锦标赛上获得奖牌。
questions.hint: 小窍门：medal 像 metal，绝大多数奖章（medal）都是金属（metal）做的。
questions.prompt: She led the China women's volleyball team to ____ at world championships.

questions.meaning: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军称号
questions.context_sentence: She led the China women's volleyball team to medals at world championships.
questions.cn: 她率领中国女子排球队在世界锦标赛上获得奖牌。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：champion (冠军) + ship (名词后缀，表示某种身份、状态或性质) = 冠军赛，锦标赛。
questions.prompt: 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军称号

questions.context_sentence: Two weeks later, they were world champions!
questions.cn: 两周后，他们成为了世界冠军！
questions.hint: 联想记忆：champ (啃，咬) + ion -> 咬牙坚持到底的就是冠军。

questions.context_sentence: When the Chinese team was preparing for the 2015 World Cup, her determination was tested.
questions.cn: 当中国队备战2015年世界杯时，她的决心受到了考验。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：determine (下决心) + ation (名词后缀) = 决心。
questions.prompt: When the Chinese team was preparing for the 2015 World Cup, her ____ was tested.

questions.context_sentence: The team that Lang Ping had built was falling apart.
questions.cn: 郎平建立的队伍正在解体。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：a (在) + part (部分) -> 每一部分都在不同的地方，即分离的。

questions.context_sentence: The team that Lang Ping had built was falling apart.
questions.cn: 郎平建立的队伍正在解体。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：fall (倒下) + apart (分开) -> 塌下并散开，即崩溃、破裂。

questions.context_sentence: He injured his leg during the match.
questions.cn: 他在比赛中伤了腿。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：in (不) + jure (法律，权利) -> 不合法的对待，引申为伤害，使受伤。
questions.prompt: He ____ his leg during the match. (提示: 使受伤)

questions.context_sentence: One of the best players had been injured.
questions.cn: 其中一名最好的队员受伤了。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：injure (使受伤) + ed (形容词后缀) = 受伤的。
questions.prompt: One of the best players had been ____.

questions.context_sentence: She recovered from her injury quickly.
questions.cn: 她很快从伤病中恢复过来。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：injure (使受伤) + y (名词后缀) = 伤害，损伤。

questions.context_sentence: The team captain had to leave because of heart problems.
questions.cn: 由于心脏问题，队不得不离开。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：cap (头) + tain (持，握) -> 团队的头目，即队长。

questions.context_sentence: Losing two important players was a big challenge, but Lang Ping did not lose heart.
questions.cn: 失去两名重要队员是一个巨大的挑战，但郎平并没有丧失信心。
questions.hint: 直译记忆：lose (失去) + heart (心) -> 失去了心，指丧失了斗志和信心。
questions.prompt: Losing two important players was a big challenge, but Lang Ping did not ____.

questions.context_sentence: The player who became known as 'Air Jordan' changed basketball with his graceful moves and jumps.
questions.cn: 被称为“飞人乔丹”的这位球员以他优雅的动作和起跳改变了篮球运动。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：grace (优雅) + ful (充满...的) = 优美的，优雅的。

questions.context_sentence: The mental strength that he showed made him unique.
questions.cn: 他表现出的精神力量使他与众不同。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：strong (强壮的) 的名词形式，将 o 变为 e 并加上 th。

questions.meaning: n. 失败；失败的人或事物
questions.context_sentence: Jordan says that the secret to his success is learning from his failures.
questions.cn: 乔丹说他成功的秘诀是向失败学习。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：fail (失败) + ure (名词后缀) = 失败。
questions.prompt: Jordan says that the secret to his success is learning from his ____.

questions.context_sentence: Losing games taught him to practise harder and never give up.
questions.cn: 输掉比赛教会了他更加努力地练习，永不放弃。
questions.hint: 直译记忆：give (给) + up (向上) -> 把手举起来，即投降、放弃。

questions.context_sentence: Now athletes from all over the world compete in this sport.
questions.cn: 现在来自世界各地的运动员在这项运动中竞争。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：com (共同) + pete (追求) -> 共同追求一个目标，即竞争。

questions.meaning: phr. 有道理；合乎情理；表述清楚
questions.context_sentence: It doesn't make sense to cheat in exams.
questions.cn: 考试作弊是没道理的。
questions.hint: 短语记忆：make (产生) + sense (感觉，意义) -> 产生意义，即讲得通、有道理。
questions.prompt: It doesn't ____ to cheat in exams. (提示: 有道理)

questions.context_sentence: He pretended to be asleep when I entered the room.
questions.cn: 当我进入房间时，他假装睡着了。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：pre (在...前) + tend (伸出) -> 在别人面前伸出（假象），即假装。
questions.prompt: He ____ to be asleep when I entered the room.

questions.context_sentence: Do not pretend to know what you do not know.
questions.cn: 不要假装知道你不知道的事。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：pretend (假装) + to do sth (做某事)。

questions.context_sentence: Find a sport you enjoy, even if it's just walking or yoga.
questions.cn: 找一项你喜欢的运动，即使只是散步或瑜伽。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：even (甚至) + if (如果) -> 即使如果，即即使、虽然。

questions.context_sentence: Millions of people watch competitions online.
questions.cn: 数百万人在网上观看比赛。
questions.hint: 数量记忆：mil (千) + lion (大) -> 大的千，即百万。

questions.meaning: vi. 作弊；舞弊 & vt. 欺骗；蒙骗 & n. 欺骗手段；骗子
questions.context_sentence: We should not cheat in any sports game.
questions.cn: 我们在任何体育比赛中都不应该作弊。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：买到便宜货 (cheap) 往往是被商家欺骗 (cheat) 了。

questions.context_sentence: The Winter Olympics offer audiences a chance to get to know more about winter sports.
questions.cn: 冬奥会为观众提供了了解更多冬季运动的机会。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：audi (听) + ence (名词后缀) -> 听的人，即听众、观众。

questions.meaning: adj. 积极的；正面的；乐观的
questions.context_sentence: Try to stay positive and active.
questions.cn: 尽量保持积极和活跃。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：pos (放置) + itive -> 摆放得稳固的，引申为确定的、积极的。

questions.context_sentence: He is tall and slim.
questions.cn: 他又高又苗条。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：s (蛇的形状) + lim (limb，肢体) -> 像蛇一样修长，即苗条的。

questions.meaning: n. 规定饮食；日常饮食 & vi. 节食
questions.context_sentence: A balanced diet is essential for fitness.
questions.cn: 均衡的饮食对健康至关重要。
questions.hint: 谐音记忆：diet 谐音“代一天”，节食减肥，吃饭找人代替一天。

questions.context_sentence: Exercising every day will make a difference.
questions.cn: 每天锻炼会有所作为/产生影响。
questions.hint: 直译记忆：make (制造) + a difference (一个不同) -> 制造出不同，即产生影响。

questions.context_sentence: It is rather cold today.
questions.cn: 今天相当冷。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：father (父亲) rather (相当) 威严。

questions.context_sentence: I prefer walking rather than running.
questions.cn: 我宁愿走路而不是跑步。
questions.hint: 对比记忆：rather (宁可) + than (比) -> 宁愿...而不是。

questions.context_sentence: He does 50 push-ups every morning.
questions.cn: 他每天早上做50个俯卧撑。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：push (推) + up (向上) -> 把身体向上推，即俯卧撑。

questions.meaning: phr. 停止做（或使用、食用）；剪下
questions.context_sentence: You should cut junk food out of your diet.
questions.cn: 你应该把垃圾食品从你的饮食中戒掉。
questions.hint: 直译记忆：cut (切) + out (出去) -> 切除出去，引申为停止、戒掉。
questions.prompt: You should ____ junk food out of your diet. (提示: 停止食用)

questions.context_sentence: We go to the gym now and then.
questions.cn: 我们偶尔去健身房。
questions.hint: 时间记忆：now (现在) and then (那时) -> 忽而现在，忽而那时，即有时、偶尔。

questions.context_sentence: If you compare this gym with that one, you'll see the difference.
questions.cn: 如果你把这个健身房和那个比较一下，你会看到区别。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：compare (比较) + with/to (和/与)。

questions.context_sentence: Do you jog often?
questions.cn: 你经常慢跑吗？
questions.hint: 慢跑能强健脚骨（jog谐音脚骨）。
questions.prompt: Do you ____ often? (提示: 慢跑)

questions.cn: 圈出说话者重读的单词。

questions.context_sentence: Find the grammatical error in the sentence.

questions.meaning: phr. 获得成功；准时到达
questions.context_sentence: You can make it!
questions.cn: 你能成功的！
questions.hint: 口语记忆：make (制造，做到) + it (它) -> 做到它，即获得成功。

questions.meaning: n. 传奇故事（或人物）；传说
questions.context_sentence: Help us choose some 'Living Legends of Sports'.
questions.cn: 帮我们选择一些“体育界的活传奇”。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：leg (腿) + end (结束) -> 腿跑到了终点，成为了传奇。

questions.context_sentence: They must be athletes who are masters in their sports.
questions.cn: 他们必须是各自运动项目中的高手。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：ath (谐音：爱死) + lete (力体) -> 爱死有力量和体魄的运动员。
questions.prompt: They must be ____ who are masters in their sports.

questions.meaning: n. 高手；主人 & vt. 精通；掌握
questions.context_sentence: They must be athletes who are masters in their sports.
questions.cn: 他们必须是各自运动项目中的高手。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：ma (妈妈) + s + ter (特) -> 妈妈是个特别的高手。

questions.context_sentence: They must also set good examples for others.
questions.cn: 他们还必须为其他人树立好榜样。
questions.hint: 直译记忆：set (树立) + an example (一个例子) = 树立榜样。

questions.context_sentence: As a player, Lang Ping brought honour and glory to her country.
questions.cn: 作为一名运动员，郎平为她的国家带来了荣誉和光荣。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：h不发音，on (在...上) + our (我们的) -> 荣誉在我们身上。
questions.prompt: As a player, Lang Ping brought ____ and glory to her country.

questions.context_sentence: As a player, Lang Ping brought honour and glory to her country.
questions.cn: 作为一名运动员，郎平为她的国家带来了荣誉和光荣。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：glo (发光，glow) + ry -> 闪闪发光的东西就是光荣。

questions.context_sentence: She led the China women's volleyball team to medals at world championships.
questions.cn: 她率领中国女子排球队在世界锦标赛上获得奖牌。
questions.hint: 小窍门：medal 像 metal，绝大多数奖章（medal）都是金属（metal）做的。

questions.meaning: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军称号
questions.context_sentence: She led the China women's volleyball team to medals at world championships.
questions.cn: 她率领中国女子排球队在世界锦标赛上获得奖牌。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：champion (冠军) + ship (名词后缀，表示某种身份、状态或性质) = 冠军赛，锦标赛。
questions.prompt: She led the China women's volleyball team to medals at world ____.

questions.context_sentence: Two weeks later, they were world champions!
questions.cn: 两周后，他们成为了世界冠军！
questions.hint: 联想记忆：champ (啃，咬) + ion -> 咬牙坚持到底的就是冠军。

questions.context_sentence: When the Chinese team was preparing for the 2015 World Cup, her determination was tested.
questions.cn: 当中国队备战2015年世界杯时，她的决心受到了考验。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：determine (下决心) + ation (名词后缀) = 决心。

questions.context_sentence: The team that Lang Ping had built was falling apart.
questions.cn: 郎平建立的队伍正在解体。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：a (在) + part (部分) -> 每一部分都在不同的地方，即分离的。
questions.prompt: The team that Lang Ping had built was falling ____.

questions.context_sentence: The team that Lang Ping had built was falling apart.
questions.cn: 郎平建立的队伍正在解体。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：fall (倒下) + apart (分开) -> 塌下并散开，即崩溃、破裂。

questions.context_sentence: He injured his leg during the match.
questions.cn: 他在比赛中伤了腿。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：in (不) + jure (法律，权利) -> 不合法的对待，引申为伤害，使受伤。

questions.context_sentence: One of the best players had been injured.
questions.cn: 其中一名最好的队员受伤了。
questions.hint: 词根词缀：injure (使受伤) + ed (形容词后缀) = 受伤的。
questions.prompt: One of the best players had been ____. (提示: 受伤的)
